prompt:
The charts below show how fresh water was used by four sectors in two regions of one country in 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Fresh water use by sector in two regions, 2020
visual.alt: Two pie charts showing the distribution of fresh water use by sector in two regions for 2020.

key_points: Water use differs sharply between the two regions: farming leads in Northmoor (62%), while industry leads in Calder Bay (38%)
In Northmoor, the share for farming is far larger than the combined share of the other three sectors (38%)
In Calder Bay, the distribution is much more even; industry, homes and farming are close to each other (38%, 33%, 21%)
The share for homes in Calder Bay is roughly double that in Northmoor (33% versus 18%)
Public services and other uses are the smallest slice in both regions (6% and 8%) and are close to each other
Both charts give a proportional breakdown, not the actual amount of water used
common_mistakes: Describing the two pie charts one after another without highlighting the most striking contrast between them (farming versus industry)
Mistaking share for amount ('Calder Bay uses more water for industry than Northmoor') — the charts give no total water figure
Reading out all eight slices one by one instead of framing the answer around the largest and smallest slices
Making mistakes when using proportion language instead of '%' (misapplying phrases like 'a third of', 'nearly two thirds')
